data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'goos' (god) and 'aino' (shepherd), Goines is a name that evokes the image of a divine protector and caregiver. In the New Testament, Jesus is referred to as the Good Shepherd, who lays down his life for his sheep. Goines is a name that embodies the qualities of faithfulness, protection, and love.

data.cultural_impact: The name Goines holds significant cultural impact for Christians, reminding us of the Biblical figure of Jesus as the Good Shepherd. This name invokes images of strength, leadership, and unwavering loyalty – the very qualities expected of a good shepherd. Goines can be seen as a nod to the rich spiritual heritage of Western civilization, deeply rooted in Christianity.
